item.title: Cloud Service Outages [postmortem]
item.description:
Many of our systems rely on Azure Front Door \(AFD\) for its ability to handle high-volume, high regional availability, fast scalability, DDOS protection and much more. There was a global outage of AFD today, this has a significant cascading effect on almost every corner of the ecosystem, including some of the Telerik systems.
Here below is a quoted description from Microsoft’s Azure Status [https://azure.status.microsoft/en-us/status](https://azure.status.microsoft/en-us/status) page. You can read more after they’ve finalized their post-incident review on the [https://azure.status.microsoft/en-us/status/history/](https://azure.status.microsoft/en-us/status/history/) page.
‌
_**Azure Front Door - Connectivity issues - Observing recovery**_
_Starting at approximately 16:00 UTC on 29 Oc
